description: This file defines the controller class 'CustomField' within the OpenCart admin module, specifically for managing customer custom fields. It includes methods for listing, editing, and adding custom fields, handling form submissions, and generating data for views related to customer custom fields.

classes.name: CustomField
classes.description: Controller class for managing customer custom fields within the OpenCart admin panel. Implements functions to display the list of custom fields, handle form submissions for creating or editing custom fields, and provide data for views.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point for displaying the list of customer custom fields. Loads language, sets the page title, builds URLs, breadcrumbs, and retrieves the list of custom fields to be displayed.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles the request to list all custom fields. Sets the response output to the list view.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves and prepares data for displaying the list of custom fields, including sorting, ordering, pagination, and building the view data array.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Handles the display of the form to create or edit a custom field. Loads necessary data such as existing custom field info, descriptions, and language options.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Not shown in the provided chunk but typically handles saving a custom field after form submission.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Not shown in the provided chunk but typically handles bulk deletion of custom fields.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving a custom field after form submission. Loads language, validates permissions, processes form data, and adds/edits record accordingly.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles bulk deletion of custom fields based on selected IDs. Checks permissions, then deletes each specified custom field.
